title: Pure Exodia
summary: The Forbidden One pieces, the Exodia cards and the Millennium monsters that exist to summon them, with generic staples. Millennium Ankh shows the five Forbidden One pieces from the hand, Deck or field and summons The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate from the Extra Deck. The Incarnate can't be destroyed by their effects, negates a Spell/Trap each turn, and sets an Exodd or Obliterate!!! card from the Deck in every End Phase. Shield of the Millennium Dynasty searches the Ankh, and Sengenjin and Golem fetch the rest of the engine. Exxod Fires of Rage wipes their field while you control a Level 10 Exodia. Break the Seal searches a missing piece, and when destroyed it bounces their cards for each piece in your hand. The five pieces are Limited, so each is a single copy. The Millennium page has its own list built around Heart of Gaia.

allow.Millennium Ankh: The Millennium Spell that summons The Unstoppable Exodia Incarnate.
allow.Sengenjin Wakes from a Millennium: Searches the Millennium monsters that lead to Millennium Ankh.
allow.Golem that Guards the Millennium Treasur: Makes Millennium Ankh unnegatable and searches Wedju Temple.
allow.Wedju Temple: Places the Millennium monsters from the Deck.
